cases.cause: No mismatch. build() sets each verse's bit from the same items it writes to the part files (crates/atlas-cli/src/extra_voices.rs:958-1003, bit set at line 972), and atlas verify already requires seen == has (extra_voices.rs:1150-1153). Whatever looks empty in this panel comes from the content of the notes (next three cases), not from the index.
cases.fix: Nothing to fix in the index or in partOf/notesOn.

cases.surface: Christian writers: the line names John Wesley, but his whole note on the verse is a bare verse reference
cases.how: Same sweep. A writer's section counts as reference only when every voice is verse links plus punctuation after Panel.tsx's paragraphs() and leadingCite() (lines 34-86, copied into the script). Seen in the browser: on Matthew 6:14 the John Wesley section reads only "Mark 11:25.", and on Mark 1:3 only "Isa 40:3.".
examples: Matthew 6:14: John Wesley shows only "Mark 11:25."
Matthew 7:12: John Wesley shows only "Luke 6:31."
Matthew 11:10: John Wesley shows only "Mal 3:1."
Matthew 22:37: John Wesley shows only "Deut 6:5."
Mark 1:3: John Wesley shows only "Isa 40:3."
Mark 7:24: John Wesley shows only "Mt 15:21."
1 Corinthians (verse 28483): John Wesley shows only "Gen 2:24."
1 Peter (verse 30390): John Wesley shows only "Lev 11:44."
cases.cause: extra_voices.rs wesley() (lines 887-937) keeps every non-empty body, including module entries that are only a cross-reference. runs() turns the reference into a link, the item is pushed (line 932) and its verse bit is set (line 972). worksOn (voices/model.ts:147-150) and note() (voices.extra.tsx:61-64) then name John Wesley, and his section in the panel holds one link and no words.
cases.fix: In wesley(), skip a note whose runs contain no words apart from verse links and punctuation, and count it in the report. The verse bit then stays clear and the line no longer names him. Add a verify check that no voice is only links. All 139 are Wesley; no Henry or Fathers note has this shape.

cases.surface: Christian writers: Matthew Henry's note on Isaiah 36 only points to 2 Kings
cases.how: Same sweep, plus a search of every voice's text for pointer-only notes (sweep\voices-see.cjs). Seen in the browser on Isaiah 36:5.
examples: Isaiah 36:1 to 36:22: Matthew Henry, "On verses 1-22", shows only "See II Kin. 18:17-37, and the commentary thereon."
cases.cause: extra_voices.rs henry() (lines 808-860) takes a chapter that Henry treats as a whole as one section across verses 1 to the chapter's end, whatever its text. For Isaiah 36 that text is a pointer, so all 22 verses get Henry's bit and the line names him. Isaiah 37 has no Henry or Wesley item, so it shows no line.
cases.fix: In henry(), drop a section that is only a pointer ("See ... thereon"). Better, place Henry's note on 2 Kings 18:17-37 on Isaiah 36 instead. Either way, check the result with the same sweep.

cases.surface: Study notes (notes extra, Study): the line says "A study note on this verse", but every note behind it only points elsewhere
cases.how: Study level, all 31,102 verses. For each verse the script took hits() (notes/model.ts:81-99) and the text of each note in extras/notes/<Book>.json, as notes/Panel.tsx:73-131 shows it. The sweep found 0 missing or empty notes (sweep\page-sweep.js). sweep\thin.cjs then listed the verses where every note behind the line is only a "See X" or "Compare X" pointer.
examples: Exodus 39:1 to 39:29 and 39:31 (30 verses): the only note is "See Exodus 28:1-43."
Genesis 7:8: "See the study note on 7:2."
Deuteronomy 14:3, 14:4, 14:5, 14:9, 14:10: "See 'Clean, Unclean, and Holy' Theme Note." (the app does not include the theme notes)
2 Chronicles 1:7, 1:8, 1:9, 1:11, 1:12: "See 'Solomon's Wisdom' Theme Note."
Acts 1:5: "baptized: See 'Baptism' Theme Note."
Luke 9:44: "See study note on 9:22."

11 more verses have only one short sentence, for example Proverbs 15:5 "To be wise, learn from your mistakes." and 1 Kings 15:9 "Asa ruled from 910 to 869 BC.". In all, 164 notes are this thin, across 421 verse-note pairs.
cases.cause: extra_notes.rs build() (lines 425-446) adds every Aquifer note that names a passage, whatever its text. notes.extra.tsx:62-68 then promises "A study note on ..." for any verse with a hit. Twelve of the 72 verses point to a Tyndale theme note that the app leaves out, so the reader cannot follow them.
cases.fix: In extra_notes.rs, leave pointer-only notes (only "See" or "Compare" plus references, or a Theme Note pointer) out of n/per, so the line does not show where they are the only note. Where another note covers the verse, keep them only as links inside it, or drop them.

cases.surface: Places (real-map): the "Places:" line opens a map that marks none of the places, or a chip the map cannot draw
cases.how: Simple level, all 4,896 verses with a Places line. I ran decodeIndex and placesLine (real-map/model.ts:142-191) and info/proposals (real-map/places.ts) over extras/real-map/places.json, as MapPanel.tsx draws markers (lines 183-215) and the lead sentence (lines 99-131). A place counts as drawn when it has a confident site or proposed sites (sweep\places.cjs, and the in-page sweep).
examples: Exodus 26:33: "Places: Holy Place, Most Holy Place". Neither is on the map; the lead says they are not marked. Holy Place alone accounts for 17 such verses (Exodus 28:29, Leviticus 16:2 and others)
1 Kings 17:10: "Place: Zarephath". Its only position (Sarepta, 100 in 100) comes from a source whose license the app does not use
Isaiah 2:16, Psalm 48:7, Isaiah 60:9, 1 Kings 10:22: Tarshish (strongest reading is not a proper name)
Judges 15:8, 15:11: Etam; Ezra 2:35 and Nehemiah 7:38: Senaah; Daniel 8:16: Ulai; Ezekiel 20:29: Bamah
41 more verses have some chips the map cannot mark, for example Genesis 4:16 Nod, Joshua 10:10 Azekah, 2 Kings 17:6 Gozan, Luke 4:26 Zarephath. 33 places are never drawn at all
cases.cause: extra_real_map.rs (lines 3168-3183) drops a mention read as not_a_place or not_a_proper_name only when that reading scores at least CONFIDENT. places.ts proposals() draws nothing when that reading is merely the strongest of all. It also draws nothing for multiple_locations (Holy Place), for a place with no site (Most Holy Place, Dinhabah) or an unknown one (Nod, Bamah), or for a site whose only position is off-licence (Azekah, Gozan, Zarephath, Etam). The line (real-map.extra.tsx:165-174) still lists every mention.
cases.fix: Use one rule in the build and the panel. Leave out of byVerse, or at least out of placesLine, every place that info/proposals cannot draw. Then no line shows on the 35 verses, and the 41 verses lose only the undrawable names. A drawable place's card still says where the uncertain one was.

For each listing the script took listingsAt (dictionary/model.ts:75-84) and loadEntry (data/shelf.ts:164-168), as dictionary/Panel.tsx:17-30 shows the entry. 0 entries are missing and 0 have no text (sweep\page-sweep.js). sweep\thin.cjs listed entries whose text, once references and bracketed see-alsos are taken out, is empty or under 25 characters.
examples: Genesis 36:24: Ajah (Smith) shows only "(Genesis 36:24)"
Numbers 26:36: Eranites (Smith) shows only "(Numbers 26:36)"
Genesis 12:6: Sichem (Smith) shows only "(Genesis 12:6) [Shechem]"
